requirement: A turn seal that ends late but seals nothing while nothing else commits on the site takes the turn's unsealed_start off, so its Undo is not refused

oracle.ref: PR #1100 (fix); fix evidence: Local stand 09/10/2026, dskeepjo.tracy.test turn session-92adbee5-821f-44fc-98b4-abf881aa13f7:1 (T4b): job 2e07c9b3d255 webroot-seal-outside ran 15.3 s on the host (16.5 s as tracy-web saw it) and answered {"sealed":null,"skipped":null,"outside":[]} with no other webroot job on the site; site_turn.unsealed_start stayed true and Undo was refused with SHARED_CHANGE cause unsealed.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 and every test in run.tests reports ok, none skipped (the database was really used). sealProvesStart is true for the dskeepjo T4b records (seal 1791570660534..1791570675835, sealed null, skipped null, door lead 40 ms; a restore that ended before, a cms-log-pull inside, the turn's own moment after). sealProvesStart is false when the seal sealed or skipped something, when the door's lead is missing or above SEAL_LEAD_MAX_MS, when the seal's host times are missing, and when a job that may commit ran inside the seal's window (a moment that committed, a sealing seal, webroot-changes, a restore, an unknown kind, a failed or unended or never-polled job); a moment that committed nothing and a seal that sealed nothing inside the window do not count. handOver marks a seal's turn unsealed_start in the same statement, marks nothing for a moment, and does not overwrite the verdict of a seal the sweep already followed through. Through the doors: POST /turn whose seal outlives the wait answers unsealedStart true; after the host ends that seal with sealed null and the follow-up sweep runs, site_turn.unsealed_start is false and nothing is owed. Through the doors: when the previous turn's moment (answered 202) committed inside the next turn's seal window, that next turn's unsealed_start stays true after the sweep.
